title: Special Technical Operations (STO) Administrator (MGySgt to Sgt) FMOS, DC PP&O #
raw_text:
8. MOS 8016, Special Technical Operations (STO) Administrator (MGySgt to
Sgt) FMOS, DC PP&O #

    a. Summary. Special Technical Operations (STO) Administrators support
the planning and integration of STO capabilities into Coalition, Joint, or
Marine Corps plans, exercises, training, and operations. They are
responsible for advising planners on specific programs and administering the
unique security requirements associated with each capability. This MOS will
be assigned only as a non-PMOS upon request from the individual and with the
concurrence of the OccFld manager.

    b. Prerequisites.       Security requirement:   top secret security clearance,
SCI eligible.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Joint Staff J-7 Planning and Decision Aid System
(PDAS) Operator's Course. This requirement may be waived based on the
applicant's demonstrated level of proficiency while serving in an operational
STO billet.

        (2) Perform at least six months in an overseas billet where STO
administration was the primary billet responsibility or one year in a CONUS
billet that required the performance of STO functions as a primary duty.

        (3) Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of STO administration, billet
management, and personnel, information, and physical security requirements.

            (4) Upon concurrence by the occupation field manager.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Supports the integration of Special Technical Operations into
Marine Corps Operational Plans.

        (2) Advises planners on the processes, requirements, and capabilities
of STO programs available.

        (3) Manages personnel, information, and physical security for Marie
Corps STO facilities and STO indoctrinated personnel.

        (4) Informs Marine Corps requirements for current and future STO
capabilities.

        (5) Informs local policy consistent with Chairman of the Joint Chiefs
of Staff and service policy.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Management Analyst 13/14-1111.

 3149                                                              NAVMC 1200.1L



       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
